watch.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is questionable after missing Week 11; 40-year-old Josh Johnson started the 34-7 loss at Kansas City. Gardner Minshew had UCL surgery.
The Cardinals fired defensive coordinator Nick Rallis on Monday; Teryl Austin takes over on an interim basis.
QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) has a possible Week 16 return; Jacoby Brissett has started Weeks 10-11 and the Ravens have lost six straight.
CB Marlon Humphrey was a healthy scratch in the 35-33 loss at Carolina; the Ravens are noncommittal on him for Houston.
CB Christian Benford (groin) did not practice Monday and TE Dalton Kincaid, RT Spencer Brown and G O'Cyrus Torrence were limited for the Thanksgiving-night game.
CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) missed Week 11 and did not practice Monday; OT Theo Benedet (quadriceps) also sat out.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) and G Tyler Booker (ankle) did not practice Monday; CB DaRon Bland is on IR.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring), on IR and designated to return, practiced fully on Monday's estimated report.
DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) is out for the season and LB Jack Campbell is on IR; our ratings still include games with both.
S Chuck Clark, CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. and edge DJ Wonnum did not practice Monday for Thanksgiving vs. Chicago.
CB D.J. Reed (hip), out the last three games, practiced fully Monday; S Kerby Joseph made his season debut in Week 11.
Edge Micah Parsons has been cleared for his season debut Wednesday at the Rams; our ratings were built without him.
LB Azeez Al-Shaair went on IR for groin surgery and DE Chris Braswell hurt his knee on the opening kickoff Nov. 19; DE Danielle Hunter is questionable.
The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson Sr. makes his first start of the season.
Both starting OTs and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward missed Week 11 and are questionable; WR Alec Pierce is shut down for the season.
OT Walker Little (knee) left the 23-18 loss to the Giants, C Robert Hainsey is questionable and RT Anton Harrison is on IR.
OT Jaylon Moore, RB Kenneth Walker III and TE Noah Gray did not practice Monday for Thursday at Buffalo.
G Trey Smith (concussion), who missed Week 11, was a full participant Monday.
WR Puka Nacua (MCL surgery) is out 4-5 months and WR Davante Adams (hamstring) is likelier back mid-December.
G Steve Avila is ruled out for Wednesday and C Coleman Shelton did not practice Sunday or Monday (both hamstring).
DT Kobie Turner (groin), designated to return from IR, practiced fully Sunday and Monday.
QB Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol after the 27-24 loss to the Jets; DJ Uiagalelei is next up if he can't clear it.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza has started Weeks 10-11 since Kirk Cousins was traded; most of our ratings were built with Cousins.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Week 11 and is questionable for Sunday night at Cleveland.
QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11, including the 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
The defensive line has lost several players for the season, most recently DT Jordan Phillips (torn biceps).
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Weeks 9-11 and is questionable; Kirk Cousins, who started Weeks 10-11, stays the starter. WR Jordan Addison is not expected to play.
QB Drake Maye (fractured right fibula, Week 10) is out; Tommy DeVito stays QB1 per Mike Vrabel, but our ratings were built with Maye.
G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) was designated to return from IR Monday.
OL: OT Asim Richards (doubtful), OT Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy (questionable) all sat the last two games; S Justin Reid was released.
CB Greg Newsome II (high ankle sprain) will miss multiple weeks, John Harbaugh said.
QB Geno Smith returned from his ankle injury for the 27-24 win at the Chargers; Cade Klubnik played much of the Week 10 loss to Buffalo.
Jalen Hurts is on IR; Tanner McKee started Weeks 7-8 and Joe Milton Weeks 9 and 11. Our ratings carry early-season games with Hurts.
CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) did not practice Monday; RB Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) and TE Dallas Goedert were limited. LB Zack Baun is on IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) returned in the Week 11 win over Pittsburgh and practiced fully Monday.
LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) is likely out Friday and LB Nick Herbig is questionable.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR) is expected back vs. Denver, per Mike McCarthy.
QB Sam Darnold, who missed Weeks 9-10 (Drew Lock started) before the bye, is set to start at San Francisco if practice goes well.
G Quenton Nelson is doubtful and LT Charles Cross questionable for Sunday.
RT Colton McKivitz fractured and dislocated his ankle vs. Minnesota and is likely out for the season; CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is still hurting.
CBs Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and Jacob Parrish (back) had MRIs Monday; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is questionable.
Three OL starters are on IR (Peter Skoronski, Jackson Slater, Fernando Carmona) and RB Tyjae Spears joined them.

2026_12_GB_LA.summary: The market is 4 pts lower on the Rams than we are: Micah Parsons debuts for Green Bay while L.A. is without Puka Nacua, Davante Adams and two interior linemen.

reasons.text: Edge Micah Parsons is cleared to make his season debut Wednesday.
Rams: WR Puka Nacua is out 4-5 months and WR Davante Adams is on IR; our ratings include games with both.
Rams OL: G Steve Avila is ruled out and C Coleman Shelton did not practice Sunday or Monday; the line opened Rams -3.5 and is -2.5.

returning.text: Season debut after last December's ACL tear.
DT designated to return from IR, full practice Sunday and Monday.

swings.GB: The market moved toward Green Bay (Rams -3.5 to -2.5) with Micah Parsons cleared to debut, while our rating fell after the 30-10 loss to Minnesota in Week 10.

2026_12_CHI_DET.summary: The market has Chicago favored; Detroit's defense is thin (Hutchinson and Campbell on IR, three more defenders not practicing), which covers part of our 5.5-pt gap.

reasons.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL, season) and LB Jack Campbell are on IR; our ratings still include their games.
S Chuck Clark, CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. and edge DJ Wonnum did not practice Monday; CB D.J. Reed returned to full practice.
Chicago's CB Kyler Gordon and OT Theo Benedet also did not practice; both teams are 8-2.

returning.text: CB back to full practice after missing three games.

2026_12_KC_BUF.summary: Buffalo is a 3-pt favorite to our 1: Kansas City has two offensive starters and a TE not practicing, but the Bills are banged up too and the forecast is windy and wet.

reasons.text: Chiefs OT Jaylon Moore, RB Kenneth Walker III and TE Noah Gray did not practice Monday; G Trey Smith was full.
Bills CB Christian Benford did not practice and TE Dalton Kincaid, RT Spencer Brown and G O'Cyrus Torrence were limited.
Forecast for Thursday night in Orchard Park: wind near 17 mph with gusts in the 30s and rain likely; the line opened Bills -2.5.

returning.text: G full practice Monday after missing Week 11 (concussion).

2026_12_NYG_IND.summary: The market makes the Giants 6.5-pt road favorites: Indianapolis cut Daniel Jones, starts Anthony Richardson Sr., and its starting tackles and top corners are questionable.

reasons.text: The Colts released Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Richardson Sr. starts.
Both starting OTs and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward missed Week 11 and are questionable; WR Alec Pierce is out for the season.
The Giants lose CB Greg Newsome II for multiple weeks; the line moved from Giants -4.5 to -6.5.

2026_12_NYJ_MIA.summary: The Jets are 3.5-pt road favorites because Miami is on its backup QB with a depleted defensive line, while the Jets have Geno Smith back.

reasons.text: QB Malik Willis is on IR; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11, including the 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
Miami's defensive line has lost several players for the season, most recently DT Jordan Phillips.
Geno Smith returned from his ankle injury in the 27-24 win at the Chargers.

returning.text: Back from his ankle injury in Week 11.

2026_12_NE_LAC.summary: The market makes the 1-9 Chargers a small favorite because New England has lost Drake Maye; Justin Herbert's concussion has already moved the line from 3.5 to 1.5.

reasons.text: QB Drake Maye (fractured fibula, Week 10) is out and Tommy DeVito stays QB1; our ratings were built with Maye.
QB Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol; DJ Uiagalelei is next up.
Patriots WR A.J. Brown missed Monday's practice; G Alijah Vera-Tucker was designated to return from IR.

returning.text: G designated to return from IR Monday.

swings.NE: Drake Maye's fractured fibula (Week 10) is priced by the market but not our ratings, which still carry his games; Herbert's concussion has moved the line 2 pts toward New England.
swings.LAC: Our rating fell after the 27-24 home loss to the Jets (Nov. 22), while the market still makes L.A. a favorite because New England is without Drake Maye; Herbert's status is open.

2026_12_WAS_ARI.summary: The market is 4.7 pts higher on Washington: Arizona may start 40-year-old Josh Johnson again, just fired its defensive coordinator and has a depleted secondary.

reasons.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is questionable after missing the 34-7 loss at Kansas City; Gardner Minshew had UCL surgery.
The Cardinals fired DC Nick Rallis on Monday; Teryl Austin is interim DC.
Jayden Daniels led a last-second drive in Monday's 22-20 win over Cincinnati; the line opened Washington -6 and is -7.5.

swings.WAS: The market moved Washington from -6 to -7.5 after Arizona started Josh Johnson in a 34-7 loss and fired DC Nick Rallis; our ratings only see results.

2026_12_SEA_SF.summary: The market is 2 pts lower on San Francisco than we are mainly because Sam Darnold is expected back at QB for Seattle, and the 49ers lost RT Colton McKivitz.

reasons.text: Sam Darnold, who missed Weeks 9-10 before the bye, is set to start if Wednesday's practice goes well.
49ers RT Colton McKivitz is likely out for the season; CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is still hurting.
Seattle has OL worries of its own: G Quenton Nelson is doubtful and LT Charles Cross questionable.

returning.text: Starting QB expected back after missing Weeks 9-10 (quadriceps/rib).
DT back at practice Monday with Darnold and LT Charles Cross after missing Week 10.

swings.SF: San Francisco's 35-10 win over Minnesota (Nov. 22) lifted our rating, while the market holds the 49ers at -3 with Sam Darnold expected back for Seattle and McKivitz lost.

2026_12_LV_CLE.summary: Cleveland is 4.5-pt favorites to our 2 because Las Vegas starts rookie Fernando Mendoza (third start, sacked five times at Denver) and may be without TE Brock Bowers.

reasons.text: Mendoza has started Weeks 10-11 since Kirk Cousins was traded; most of our ratings were built with Cousins.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Week 11 and is questionable.
The line moved from Cleveland -3.5 to -4.5; the Sunday-night forecast has wind near 16 mph.

swings.HOU: Houston's 26-3 win over Indianapolis (Nov. 19) lifted our rating more than the market moved; Houston is -6.5 vs. a Ravens team on backup QB Jacoby Brissett, with DT Nnamdi Madubuike and S Jaylinn Hawkins uncertain.
